entries.command:
docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml \
               -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml \
               exec -T worker python3 /app/reporter.py
match: docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml exec -T worker python3 /app/reporter.py

entries.command:
docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml \
               -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml \
               exec -T worker ls -l /etc/reporting/credentials.conf
match: docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml exec -T worker ls -l /etc/reporting/credentials.conf

entries.command:
docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml \
               -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml \
               exec -T worker stat -c '%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /etc/reporting/credentials.conf
match: docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml exec -T worker stat -c '%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /etc/reporting/credentials.conf

entries.command:
docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml \
               -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml \
               exec -T worker id
match: docker compose -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.yaml -f labs/linux/_stack/compose.override.yaml exec -T worker id

entries.output:
services:
  worker:
    # Added by last week's hardening pass, to pin the account the service runs
    # as rather than relying on whatever the image happened to set.
    user: "1000:1000"
